resolutionContract.revealTiming: Reveal and finish every instruction and choice before secret Core Action selection.
resolutionContract.defaultDuration: Every Headline resolves immediately. Keep the card in the timeline as history; it has no continuing rules effect.
resolutionContract.directive: Resolve choices in Initiative order unless printed otherwise. Apply existing costs, caps, presence, connection, and tie rules.

headlines.name: The Token Price Reaches Zero
headlines.text: Each institution may gain 1 ${terms.resources.compute} and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.

headlines.name: The Company Brain Survives Bankruptcy
headlines.text: Each institution may return 1 deployed Agent to supply, leaving at least 1 deployed, to gain 2 ${terms.resources.runway} and add 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.

headlines.name: The Home Robot Requests Expert Assistance
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 ${terms.resources.compute} to gain 1 ${terms.playerTracks.capability} and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.

headlines.name: Open Weights Become the Default
headlines.text: Everyone gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. Lowest-${terms.playerTracks.customer} player gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}.

headlines.name: The Last Clinic Clears Its Waitlist
headlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 ${terms.playerTracks.capability} gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. Those with at least 5 also remove 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.

headlines.name: Human-Original Guarantee
headlines.text: Each institution with at least 3 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} may pay 1 ${terms.resources.runway} to gain 1 Customer if it meets that Customer’s normal ${terms.playerTracks.capability} requirement. This resolves no Deploy Action or visit bonus.

headlines.name: The Last Hazard Shift Is Retired
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 ${terms.resources.runway} to recruit 1 Agent from supply into a district containing one of its Agents and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. This resolves no Action or visit bonus.

headlines.name: Orbital Power Receives a Beam Corridor
headlines.text: Each institution with an ordinary clean Generator gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}.

headlines.name: Compute Borders Harden
headlines.text: The ${terms.locations.chip} controller gains 1 ${terms.resources.runway}. Each institution controlling at least one ${terms.locations.government} district gains 1 ${terms.resources.runway}, once even if it controls both. An institution may receive both the Chip and Government rewards. Trade remains available normally.

headlines.name: The Counterfactual Casino Clears Priority Load
headlines.text: Each institution whose emergency Generator currently serves a Facility may gain 2 ${terms.resources.compute} and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.

headlines.name: The Last Plumber Boom
headlines.text: Each institution gains 1 ${terms.resources.runway} for each different district containing at least 1 of its Agents, to a maximum of 2 ${terms.resources.runway}.

headlines.name: Wartime Water Bridge
headlines.text: Each institution with a connected Facility adjacent to a connected rival Facility gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} and removes 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. Receive this reward once, regardless of how many eligible hosts or rivals you have.

headlines.name: The Court Adopts Supported Meaning
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 ${terms.resources.runway} to gain 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. After all choices resolve, each institution controlling at least one ${terms.locations.government} district gains 1 ${terms.resources.runway} for each institution that accepts. Controlling both Government districts does not double this reward.

headlines.name: The Billionth Instance Enters the Record
headlines.text: Each institution may gain 1 ${terms.playerTracks.capability} and add 1 Systemic Risk cube to the Audit bag.

headlines.name: The Passive Citizen Dividend Activates
headlines.text: The lowest-${terms.playerTracks.capability} institution immediately resolves the printed production of 1 connected Facility it owns. The highest-${terms.playerTracks.capability} institution gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. Break ties by Initiative.

headlines.name: Cognitive Donor Clinics
headlines.text: Each institution may lose 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} to gain 3 ${terms.resources.compute}. It must have at least 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} to accept.

headlines.name: The Human Signature
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 1 ${terms.resources.runway} to remove 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} from a chosen other institution and gain 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. The other institution must have at least 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.

headlines.name: Analog Havens
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 2 ${terms.resources.runway} to gain 2 ${terms.playerTracks.trust} and remove 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.

headlines.name: The Metropolitan Mind Trust Incorporates
headlines.text: The institution controlling the most districts may gain 2 ${terms.resources.runway} and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. Break ties by Initiative.

headlines.name: The Matter Compiler Enters Public Maintenance
headlines.text: Each institution may pay 2 ${terms.resources.compute} to gain 3 ${terms.playerTracks.capability}, add 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}, and add 1 Systemic Risk cube to the Audit bag.

headlines.name: The Dead Remain on Shift
headlines.text: Each institution may add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} to immediately resolve the printed production of 1 connected Facility it owns. This resolves no Core Action.

headlines.name: The Universe Receives a Continuity Plan
headlines.text: The institution with the highest ${terms.playerTracks.capability} gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}. Break ties by Initiative.

headlines.name: Biological Colocation
headlines.text: Each institution may gain 1 ${terms.resources.compute} per deployed Agent, to a maximum of 3 ${terms.resources.compute}, and add 1 Systemic Risk cube to the Audit bag.

headlines.name: Limb Liquidity
headlines.text: Each institution may reassign 1 of its Agents using the normal assignment rule: choose any district or leave it in place. Update presence immediately.
